Frac balls are `specialized, high-strength spheres used in hydraulic fracturing to isolate wellbore stages and divert fluid, creating multiple fractures in a single horizontal well` . They are dropped into the well to seat in specific sleeves, allowing for high-pressure fracturing before dissolving or being drilled out. Common materials include [dissolvable magnesium](https://www.google.com/search?q=dissolvable+magnesium&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgAEA8), [aluminum](https://www.google.com/search?q=aluminum&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgAEBA), [PEEK](https://www.google.com/search?q=PEEK&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgAEBE), [Torlon](https://www.google.com/search?q=Torlon&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgAEBI) , and [phenolic compounds](https://www.google.com/search?q=phenolic+compounds&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgAEBM).[[1]](https://www.craigtechnologies.com/frac-balls.html#:~:text=A%20frac%20ball%20is%20a%20temporary%20plug,to%20divert%20water%20away%20from%20the%20well)[[2]](https://www.wingoil.com/4-things-you-should-know-about-the-frac-ball/)[[3]](https://drakeplastics.com/drake-cannonball-frac-balls-overview/)[[4]](https://www.precisionplasticball.com/blog/post/ppc-balls-hydraulic-fracking#:~:text=Frac%20balls%20come%20in%20multiple%20sizes%20and,of%20stainless%20steel%2C%20carbon%20steel%2C%20and%20aluminum.)[[5]](https://www.wingoil.com/frac-ball-coated-dissolvable-ball/)[[6]](https://www.parker.com/content/dam/Parker-com/Literature/Composite-Sealing-Systems-Division/CSS-5173---Dissolvable-Frac-Balls.pdf#:~:text=Parker's%20dissolvable%20aluminum%20alloy%20frac%20balls%20exhibit,dissolvable%20aluminum-based%20alloys%20can%20be%20used%20in)

Aaron Burton YouTube• Apr 6, 2017](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S1OWFre-f1U&t=48) **Key Aspects of Frac Balls:** 

- **Purpose:** They provide temporary sealing to build up the necessary pressure to fracture specific zones, increasing efficiency.
- **Dissolvable Technology:** Modern balls are often dissolvable, dissolving in brine or water after the fracture is complete, which eliminates the need for expensive, time-consuming drill-outs.
- **Material Selection:** Engineers select materials based on pressure and temperature, with options like PAI (Torlon) for extreme pressure (up to 22,000 PSI) and dissolvable metals for efficiency.
- **Staged Process:** The process uses progressively larger balls to open subsequent sleeves, enabling multiple stages.
- **Materials:** Common materials include engineered plastics, composites, and alloys chosen for their resistance to chemicals and abrasion.[[1]](https://www.bakerhughes.com/completions/multistage-completion-solutions/frac-sleeve-systems/ballactuated-sleeves/intallic-disintegrating-frac-balls)[[2]](https://www.wingoil.com/4-things-you-should-know-about-the-frac-ball/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S1OWFre-f1U&t=29)[[4]](https://daviesmolding.com/catalog/products/frac-balls/)[[5]](https://www.precisionplasticball.com/blog/post/ppc-balls-hydraulic-fracking#:~:text=Frac%20balls%20come%20in%20multiple%20sizes%20and,of%20stainless%20steel%2C%20carbon%20steel%2C%20and%20aluminum.)[[6]](https://www.redwoodplastics.com/frac-balls-which-material-is-optimal/)[[7]](https://www.parker.com/content/dam/Parker-com/Literature/Composite-Sealing-Systems-Division/CSS-5173---Dissolvable-Frac-Balls.pdf#:~:text=Parker's%20dissolvable%20aluminum%20alloy%20frac%20balls%20exhibit,dissolvable%20aluminum-based%20alloys%20can%20be%20used%20in)

**Commonly Used Materials:** 

- **[PAI (Torlon)](https://www.google.com/search?q=PAI+%28Torlon%29&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgBEBc):** Known for high strength (up to 22,000 PSI) and high temperature stability (up to 2 6 0∘𝐶 / 5 0 0∘𝐹).
- **[PEEK](https://www.google.com/search?q=PEEK&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgBEBs):** Resistant to chemicals and abrasion.
- **[Phenolic/G-10](https://www.google.com/search?q=Phenolic%2FG-10&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgBEB0):** Reliable, common choice for traditional applications.
- **[Dissolvable Alloy/Magnesium](https://www.google.com/search?q=Dissolvable+Alloy%2FMagnesium&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjyrYe4lpGUAxXpzDgGHS6EFRwQgK4QegYIAQgBEB8):** Designed to dissolve to minimize intervention.[[1]](https://www.bakerhughes.com/completions/multistage-completion-solutions/frac-sleeve-systems/ballactuated-sleeves/intallic-disintegrating-frac-balls)[[2]](https://www.redwoodplastics.com/frac-balls-which-material-is-optimal/)[[3]](https://www.precisionplasticball.com/blog/post/ppc-balls-hydraulic-fracking#:~:text=Frac%20balls%20come%20in%20multiple%20sizes%20and,of%20stainless%20steel%2C%20carbon%20steel%2C%20and%20aluminum.)[[4]](https://www.wingoil.com/frac-ball-coated-dissolvable-ball/)

These balls are crucial for improving the efficiency of shale gas and tight oil recovery.[[1]](https://www.wingoil.com/4-things-you-should-know-about-the-frac-ball/)
